start_here: Say to your AI: "Search the treg catalog for backlinks summary for a domain, and show me the 3 cheapest matches." It runs tool:search-the-treg-catalog with {"job":"backlinks summary for a domain","limit":3}; nothing is spent.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list of yours: it reads treg's public catalog with the job you name and spends nothing.
instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Search the treg catalog for backlinks summary for a domain", and name how many matches you want (limit, 1 to 25, default 10).
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:search-the-treg-catalog and {"job": ..., "limit": ...}. No treg account or token is needed.
3. Read the matches: each has its id, method and cost (usd per unit). Pick by the inputs you hold first, then by how often it works, then by price.
4. Read the chosen id in full with tool:read-a-treg-endpoint-and-its-price before calling it with tool:call-a-treg-endpoint.

worked_examples.title: Find a backlinks endpoint and its price
worked_examples.ask: Search the treg catalog for a backlinks summary for a domain.
worked_examples.given: Read from tools/treg/tool-rows.json: the row sends GET https://treg.to/catalog/search?q=backlinks summary for a domain&limit=3 with no token and returns treg's reply unchanged (result_selector "$"). Endpoint id taken from tools/treg/test/treg-rows.test.mjs.

drafted_from: tools/treg/tool-rows.json (its row), its README and test/treg-rows.test.mjs; the reply values are a worked sample of the shape its output_schema names
